label: First Strike Actor
description: Who initiated the February 28, 2026 strikes on Iran. The US and Israel launched a coordinated joint surprise attack — the largest US aerial campaign since the 2003 invasion of Iraq.

source.citation: Al Jazeera, 'US and Israel launch massive strikes on Iran', 28 Feb 2026; PBS NewsHour, 'US-Israeli joint operation targets Iran', 28 Feb 2026

label: Scale of Initial Strikes
description: The scale of the initial strike campaign. Approximately 900 strikes were conducted in the first 12 hours, hitting targets across 26 of 31 Iranian provinces. By late March, over 11,000 targets had been struck.

source.citation: CFR, 'The U.S.-Iran War: A Timeline', Mar 2026; BBC News, '900 strikes in 12 hours: the opening salvo', 1 Mar 2026; Wikipedia, '2026 United States–Iran conflict'

label: Supreme Leader Killed
description: Whether Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in the strikes. Khamenei was confirmed killed on February 28, 2026, in the opening wave of the US-Israeli attack.

source.citation: Al Jazeera, 'Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei killed in US-Israeli strikes', 28 Feb 2026; Reuters, 'Khamenei death confirmed by Iranian state media', 1 Mar 2026

label: Senior Security Officials Killed
description: Number of senior Iranian security officials killed in the strikes. Defense Minister Nasirzadeh, IRGC Ground Forces Commander Pakpour, and at least 7 other senior security leaders were killed.

source.citation: BBC News, 'Iran's defence minister, IRGC commander among dead', 1 Mar 2026; CFR, 'Iran Leadership Losses', Mar 2026; Wikipedia, '2026 United States–Iran conflict'

label: Nuclear Facility Damage
description: Extent of damage to Iran's nuclear enrichment infrastructure. Natanz entrances were struck, Fordow was rendered inoperable (from combined June 2025 and Feb 2026 strikes). The centrifuge enrichment program was effectively destroyed.

source.citation: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists, 'Iran's enrichment program: post-strike assessment', Mar 2026; Britannica, 'Iran nuclear program'; Al Jazeera, 'Natanz, Fordow struck in opening wave', 28 Feb 2026

label: Military Infrastructure Damage
description: Extent of damage to Iran's broader military infrastructure. Strikes hit targets across 26 of 31 provinces, with Tehran most heavily targeted. Over 11,000 targets struck by late March.

source.citation: PBS NewsHour, 'Scope of US strikes across Iran', Mar 2026; ACLED, 'Iran conflict data', Mar 2026; Wikipedia, '2026 United States–Iran conflict'

label: Iranian Civilian Casualties (Initial Phase)
description: Scale of Iranian civilian casualties from the initial strikes and sustained campaign. As of late March 2026: 1,937+ killed, 24,800+ injured, including 4,000 women and 1,621 children. Over 120 historical sites damaged.

source.citation: Al Jazeera, 'Iran death toll surpasses 1,900', Mar 2026; WHO, 'Iran humanitarian situation report', Mar 2026; Wikipedia, '2026 United States–Iran conflict'

label: Immediate International Reaction
description: The international community's immediate response to the strikes. Russia and China both issued strong condemnations. The UN Security Council held emergency sessions. Most nations outside the US-Israel alliance condemned the attack.

source.citation: Reuters, 'Russia, China condemn US-Israeli strikes on Iran', 1 Mar 2026; UN News, 'Security Council holds emergency session on Iran', Mar 2026; Al Jazeera, 'World reacts to Iran strikes', 28 Feb 2026

label: US Stated War Aims
description: The official US objectives as stated by President Trump: eliminate Iran's nuclear and missile programs, destroy its navy, and change the country's leadership. This went beyond limited counter-proliferation to explicit regime change goals.

source.citation: PBS NewsHour, 'Trump outlines war aims against Iran', Mar 2026; CFR, 'US Objectives in Iran Conflict', Mar 2026; BBC News, 'Trump: We will change Iran's leadership', Mar 2026

label: Element of Surprise Achieved
description: Whether the US-Israeli attack achieved tactical surprise. The strikes on February 28 were launched without warning, catching Iran's leadership and military off guard. Air defenses were overwhelmed in the opening hours.

source.citation: CFR, 'The Surprise Attack on Iran', Mar 2026; BBC News, 'How the US-Israel strike caught Iran off guard', Mar 2026

label: Iranian Air Defense Effectiveness (Initial)
description: Performance of Iran's air defense systems in the opening hours. Despite possessing Russian-supplied S-300 systems and indigenous Bavar-373, Iranian air defenses were overwhelmed by the scale and sophistication of the combined US-Israeli assault.

source.citation: IISS, 'Iran air defense assessment post-strikes', Mar 2026; Al Jazeera, 'Iran's air defenses overwhelmed in opening wave', 1 Mar 2026; CSIS, 'Lessons from the Iran Strikes', Mar 2026
